falsification_conditions.condition: Price closes above $150 (key resistance level) for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A clear breakout would invalidate the HOLD signal by indicating a strong bullish trend contrary to the current UNKNOWN verdict.

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score increases to 70 or higher within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score exceeding 70 would signal extreme overbought conditions, directly contradicting the current HOLD and suggesting an imminent crash.

falsification_conditions.condition: Trading volume surges by 200% above the 30-day average within 7 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Such a volume spike would indicate a major market shift (either bullish or bearish), falsifying the HOLD by proving a clear directional move.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
